name: Sonic Riders Enhanced
summary: Sonic Riders Enhanced (SRE) is a ROM Hack for Sonic Riders (2006) on the Nintendo GameCube. Sonic Riders Enhanced is a Sister Mod and Partnered Project of Sonic Riders Future. The mod focuses on offering many different gear changes, stage changes, quality of life changes and so much more. Along with making the game the best it can be for casual play and competitive play alike while staying true to the game's overall mechanics.
